BiblicalUsage: Zow is a form of the word for 'this' — Hosea uses it once, for Ephraim: 'they return, but not to the most High,' and this is their derision in the land of Egypt. One word, one verse, and it points at a people who turned everywhere except toward God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hosea's 'this' convicts me: returning to everything except God is no return at all.
